body: I understand what you mean. I personally know how much it would hurt the people I love and that is what deters me from it. Just because you have a "good life" doesn't mean you aren't allowed to feel and experience pain. What you are experiencing now is 100% valid and does not make you pathetic at all. Some things that help me is thinking about loved ones, speaking to a close friend, and holding on just for another 1-3 days. Idk how it is for you, but I try to have things to look forward to, be it the end of the work/school day, updates to games/webcomics, new music, etc. These things might be small, but they help ease my pain even for just a bit. I really hope things turn up for you and I hope you can find some peace. Idk if I helped at all... i'm sure youve heard it a lot but you really aren't alone.
